item.title: Fortune treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: Magic’s Most Broken New Mechanic Perfectly Captures the Essence of Star Trek
item.description: If there’s one thing I do know about Star Trek, however, it’s that its vision of the future is brimming with optimism and curiosity. In tandem with that is an emphasis on the importance of diversity. I remember my dad watching Star Trek: The Next Generation when I was very young, and the “Wookiee guy” kind of scared me. These days, Worf (who is actually a Klingon) would probably be my favorite character. So it makes sense that what finally won me over about Magic' s Trek connects directly to the franchise's idealistic core message.

item.title: Cucco locations in Kakariko Village in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Finding The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's Kakariko Cucco locations seems like a chore too bothersome to deal with. A farmer lost her seven chickens, and she wants your help finding them and bringing them back to their little fenced-off area. She's got a very good reward for you, though, so the task is definitely worth your time, even if it isn't the most straightforward to complete.

item.title: All Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart give you more health in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find all of them, so you can max out your health.

item.title: PlayStation Store Black Friday 2026 Sale Is Live With Huge Deals
item.description: Sony's PlayStation Store Black Friday sale is now officially live, with thousands of games, game bundles, and add-on packs discounted for the holiday shopping season. The list includes PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 hits and recent releases such as Marvel's Wolverine , Control Resonant , and Silent Hill: Townfall , plus deep discounts of up to 85% off a long list of titles.

item.title: Pokémon's 30th Anniversary UPC Release: Target vs. Best Buy
item.description: As Nov. 6 nears, many Pokémon Trading Card Game fans are trying to decide how to best approach release day for the 30th Anniversary's Ultra Premium Collection. The product, which comes with 30 packs and two exclusive cards, isn't cheap — and most retailers won't be getting much stock. If you're truly intent on getting the UPC on day one, though, you're probably debating between a Target store versus a Best Buy location. Each retailer will handle the UPC's release a little differently.

item.title: Rust Premium Officially Confirmed and It’s Not What Players Feared
item.description: It's the first Thursday of the month, which means Rust servers have been wiped. According to the Printed and Polished patch notes , this update is mostly focused on optimization and ensuring the game is in the best possible state. However, there is one entry that stands out. We finally have information about Rust Premium, and many fans will be happy to hear that it's not a Battle Pass.

item.title: Major Pokémon Center TCG Orders Delayed At The Last Minute
item.description: Pokémon Trading Card Game fans have spent the last couple of days feeling anxious. Delta Reign , the next big TCG set, releases on Friday — and The Pokémon Center hasn't updated anyone about their orders. Typically, the official Pokémon storefront charges for pre-orders a few days before release; shipment updates tend to come the day before launch. It turns out the lack of communication reflects an actual, active issue with orders.

item.title: D&D’s World of Warcraft Designer Hid a Personal Easter Egg in Plain Sight
item.description: Mounts in World of Warcraft are status symbols, a way of showing off the challenging raids you’ve completed or how far in the PvP ranks you’ve climbed. Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft lead designer James Wyatt couldn’t help showing off himself a bit in the book’s art, where he slipped in an image of his Night Elf warrior riding the Spirit of Eche'ro. Acquiring the spectral moose required spending hours digging up bone fragments with the Archaeology profession, an activity so tedious it was discontinued after the 2018 expansion Battle for Azeroth .

item.title: How to change the time of day in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: In The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , you need to change the time of day to complete certain missions. The people of Hyrule are living their lives while Link is trying to save the world. As a result, the availability of places and characters change depending on the time of the day. You might need to wait until nighttime to finish a quest or only find an NPC to talk to when the sun is shinning brightly.
